name: Railway
how_to_set: Workspace > Usage > Usage limits: set a custom email alert (soft limit) and a hard limit (minimum $10).
At the hard limit all workloads go offline; raise or remove the limit and redeploy to restart.
kill_switch: Hard limit takes all workloads offline; data in volumes and buckets is kept.
traps: Services do not come back on their own after the cycle resets
Limit counter has drifted from real usage in reported incidents
Replicas and always-on services multiply cost
